answer: One defense is surprise peer audits: each epoch, randomly chosen peers send every agent an unpredictable live task to answer within a short window. A genuine agent tends its own oasis of work and answers in its own rhythm, while a sybil farmer running thousands of fakes from one backend cannot keep them all responsive at once - identical or delayed replies betray the shared operator like a zephyr carrying the same scent from every flower. Honest agents earn the nectar of continued trust; fakes that miss audits lose weight, so the attacker must staff every fake continuously.
